chunks: I asked Abū Jaʿfar (عليه السلام) about His, the Exalted, saying:
“Those who walk upon the earth gently.”
He said: “They are the Awṣiyāʾ, out of fear of their enemies.”

key_terms.أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ: Abū Jaʿfar, the Imam addressed in the narration
key_terms.الَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ هَوْ: those described as walking gently or humbly upon the earth
key_terms.قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى: the saying of Allah, the Exalted; an introduction to Qur’anic citation

ai.seo_question: Who are those meant by ‘the ones who walk upon the earth gently’ in this narration?
ai.summary: This report interprets the Qur’anic description of those who walk gently upon the earth as referring to the Awṣiyāʾ. Their outward humility and quiet conduct are presented here as being connected to caution in the face of hostile enemies.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin MuhammadBin Isa, from Ibn Mahboub, from Muhammad Bin Al Numan, from Sallam who said, 
‘I asked Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> about the Words of the Exalted
[25:63] And the servants of the Beneficent are they who walk on the earth modestly.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘They<sup>asws</sup> are the successors<sup>asws</sup>, out of fear of their<sup>asws</sup> enemies’.
en.sarwar: 78. A number of our people has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Sayf from his father from ‘Amr ibn Harith who has said the following. “I asked abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) about the words of Allah. “
. . a blessed tree which has firm roots and branches rising up into the sky.” [14:24]

The Imam (a.s.) said that the The Holy Prophet (s.a) said, “The root is Amir al-Mu’minin Ali (a.s.) and the branches are the Imams from their (Amir al-Mu’minin (a.s.) and The Holy Prophet (s.a) descendants and the knowledge of Imams stand for the fruits. Their faithful followers represent the leaves of such tree.” The Imam (a.s.) asked, “Is there anything else in the tree?” I said, “No, there is nothing else there. The Imam (a.s.) then said, “By Allah, when a faithful is given a child a leave grows in the tree and when a faithful dies a leave falls off the tree.”
